---
title: "Capacitance"
sidebar: simulation
---

Calculate a pad island's capacitance relative to surrounding ground.
Start with SimplePad when you need an explicit conductor/reference arrangement
rather than a full-wave transmission model.

## Model and prerequisites

Preserve the island, nonmetal opening, ground, dielectric substrate, and
surrounding region from the selected tutorial. Choose the potential reference
and exterior treatment before comparing matrix values.

Use the tutorial's SCGSim environment and either Palace or AEDT Q3D.
[Layers & Stack](../../start/layers.qmd) and
[Materials & Interfaces](../../start/materials.qmd) explain the process inputs.

## Read the result

Read capacitance with units, conductor order, reference, and any matrix
reduction. Inspect the requested setup and adaptive history beside the quantity.
Different exterior or conductor conventions require separate interpretation.

For natural modes, continue with [Resonance & Eigenmodes](eigenmode.qmd);
for a uniform line, use [Cross-section Simulation](q2d-cross-section.qmd).
